# Version 3.119.2
> **Native hardening update** · Released February 6, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/3.119.2) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v3.119.2)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](3.119.2/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/8.3.1.3/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 3.119.2 adds tvOS surface overloads and strengthens native binary protections. Android symbols are now preserved in packages, improving diagnostics for Android consumers.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this release.*

## API Surface

- **Missing tvOS surface overloads added** — tvOS applications can use the complete SKSurface.Create overload set. — ❤️ [@MartinZikmund](https://github.com/MartinZikmund) ([#3342](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3342))

## Platform

- **Android symbols preserved in packages** — Android native symbols are retained to make crash diagnostics and symbolication more useful. ([#3374](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3374))

## Security

- **Windows and Linux native binaries hardened** — Native assets are built with Control Flow Guard and buffer security checks where supported. — ❤️ [@Aguilex](https://github.com/Aguilex) ([#3397](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3397), [#3404](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3404), [#3497](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3497), [#3503](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3503))

## HarfBuzzSharp 8.3.1.3

Carries the HarfBuzzSharp native hardening work with the 3.119.2 package set.
